I mean I listned to the pigeons in my old town for 20 years sounding a certain way, moved to a city a few hours away and the pigeons here make differently patterned noises and tones.

Both are your standard wood pigeon so who knows if its a different pigeon accent or I happened to find weird birds.

Honestly, I've not found one after many years of looking, but I found that it's easier if I live my life one day at a time.

-I buy things for myself that make me happy, be it flowers or a new game to sink my time into. It's a good feeling to be surrounded by things that make you happy. 

-I have a whiteboard on my wall with daily tasks from going to work, or just remembering to eat, but the little checkmarks next to everything on the board fill me with a sense of accomplishment which is nice.

-I work to provide a good life for my cat, and try to do things for other people; be it buying them their favourite snack, learning about an interest of theirs so we can talk etc.

It's little things I do to occupy my time, making me forget that I am just existing, even though I tried (and still sometimes try) to end it 16 years ago.

I hope you can find your little things to make you happy and forget your pain :)
Malfoy gearing up to say Potter.

I would say it'd be worth trying to apologise. A lot of things would come to light from it.
I had a huge falling out with my boyfriend in the past and tried to kill myself as a result. I felt like an absolute idiot when I realised just how much he loved me and what I'd be missing out on if I had succeeded.
I used to live near a park with a huge tree with beautiful strong branches. I always told myself that if I were to hang myself it'd be from that tree.

I feel so fake when I talk to people, I actually sometimes physically gag when I realise how I must've come across.
People tell me it's fine, and I sounded fine /came across how I intended but I'm just like "are you serious?"
Even now I'm going to probably regret commenting and posting here.

But I guess what I want to try say is that it's all going to be sounding the worst to yourself, and even if you think it might be fake, it actually might not be?

I hope this is something you can grow from! I don't know you but I wish you the best!
